newsitem.title: USA: Clinton declares Virginia a disaster area.
newsitem.headline: Clinton declares Virginia a disaster area.

text.p: President Bill Clinton on Friday declared Virginia a major disaster area after Hurricane Fran wreaked havoc throughout the coastal state.
"We will do everything we can to help the people of Virginia recover from the effects of Hurricane Fran," Clinton said in a statement.
Clinton's action, which follows his declaration of North Carolina as a disaster area earlier on Friday, makes victims eligible to federal assistance in dealing with the storm damage.
